statement: A lifter logging a cardio set on a phone types the duration in the mm:ss field, but the phone's numeric keyboard has no colon key, so a duration such as 11 minutes 46 seconds cannot be entered. Make the duration parser used for cardio sets accept a dot or a comma in place of the colon wherever a colon is accepted today (minutes and seconds, or hours, minutes and seconds). Inputs that are invalid today must stay invalid, including out-of-range seconds and malformed separators. Keep the change focused and keep the existing tests green.
leakage: The snapshot is an archive of the base tree with a fresh one-commit history: no later commit, PR text or lesson exists in it.
The fix commit also changed the input mode, the copy and the program prompt; only lib/cardio.ts is in scope and graded.
The original user feedback is quoted in the fix commit message, which the agent never sees.
